newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah touches ceiling after fixing.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah touches ceiling after fixing.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah touched the ceiling of the central bank intervention band after a higher fixing in the afternoon, dealers said on Wednesday.
They said the central bank was likely to have absorbed some dollars from the market, but they did not expect the amount to be significant due to slow trading after a two-day holiday.
The market was closed on Monday and Tuesday for Eid al-Fitr.
One local bank dealer said some players were seen to have accumulated some dollars below the 2,377.0 level earlier on speculation of a higher fixing which materialised.
Spot rupiah was at 2,376.90/77.00 at 0830 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,376.75/77.50. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,376.0/76.3 and 2,375.25/75.50, respectively.
The bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,377/2,569 and the conversion band to 2,377/2,425 on Wednesday, the first depreciation this week after four points last week.
The rupiah was depreciated by three points the previous week.
The dealer said a sharp fall of overnight money to nine percent from 15.5 percent reflected the market's perception that overnight money was driven up by rises in swap rates.
